thread:
maria.gomez: quick ask — I'm digging into a user-reported indexing failure in analytics-prod. I need ephemeral admin to run a targeted pg_dump of analytics.logs and pull a 2GB chunk of the last 48h for redaction and analysis.

jason_hu: can you confirm the exact tables and a ticket link? we should minimize blast radius.

maria.gomez: tables: analytics.logs and analytics.event_meta. ticket: INC-3427. only need SELECT on those schemas and ability to run \`pg_dump -t analytics.logs -t analytics.event_meta --data-only --where=\"ts >= now() - interval '48 hours'\"\`.

dinesh_p: estimated time to complete? will you be copying data off-network?

maria.gomez: expecting ~20-30min work, will SCP the dump to our internal secure bucket (s3://redwood-secure/forensics/INC-3427). no external transfers.

ella_security: tagging in sec. please include justification and duration. remember policy: short-lived console/db elev for debugging max 1 hour, must be approved by on-call security or a manager. Also confirm you'll run redaction script before handing artifacts to product.

maria.gomez: understood. justification: reproduce and triage indexing failure, verify missing events. duration requested: 45 minutes to be safe. will run the standard redaction pipeline (script: \`tools/redact/pii_filter.py\`) before upload.

ella_security: ok — on-call (ella_security) approves 30m window immediately, escalation to manager if more time needed. Please post a short runbook message when you start and when you finish. I'll trigger the JIT access.

audit-bot: Access request logged: requester=maria.gomez, resources=[analytics.logs, analytics.event_meta], ticket=INC-3427, requested_duration=2700s, policy_check=passed. pending_approval=ella_security.

ella_security: granted temporary DB role \"incidents_readonly_jit\" for 30 minutes starting now. Audit ID: AB-20260315-7782. Actions will be captured.

maria.gomez: copying the exact command for visibility:
```
PGPASSWORD=*** pg_dump -h prod-db.redwood.internal -U incidents_readonly_jit -d redwood_prod -t analytics.logs -t analytics.event_meta --data-only --where=\"ts >= now() - interval '48 hours'\" > /tmp/inc3427.dump
scp /tmp/inc3427.dump s3://redwood-secure/forensics/INC-3427/
```

jason_hu: nice. please sanitize and run redact before uploading. ping when done so I can re-run the failing index job.

maria.gomez: running now — will post timestamps.

audit-bot: Access granted: user=maria.gomez, role=incidents_readonly_jit, duration=1800s, start=1746257895, audit_id=AB-20260315-7782.

maria.gomez: finished dump and redaction, upload complete to s3://redwood-secure/forensics/INC-3427 (uploader: maria.gomez). runbook: pulled 1.8GB, redacted PII fields (email, phone, ip), uploaded, removed local copy.

jason_hu: received, thanks. I kicked the index job; monitoring.

ella_security: closing the JIT window early. please confirm no further accesses needed; if more, open a new request and include manager approval.

maria.gomez: confirmed — no further access needed. thanks :thumbsup:

audit-bot: Access window closed: user=maria.gomez, audit_id=AB-20260315-7782, end=1746258005."
